purpose.zh: 撑在双杠上，只靠肩膀往下压把身子顶高，练背和肩膀
purpose.en: On dip bars, lift your body just by pressing your shoulders down. Builds your back and shoulders.

text.zh: 手臂伸直，肩膀往下压把身子顶高
text.en: Arms straight, press your shoulders down to lift your body

text.zh: 放松时肩膀慢慢往耳朵升，手臂别弯。
text.en: As you sink, let your shoulders rise slowly toward your ears. Arms stay straight.

text.zh: 顶上停 1 秒，两腿伸直并拢。
text.en: Hold 1 second at the top, legs straight together.

commonErrors.zh: 手肘一弯一弯，成了双杠臂屈伸
commonErrors.en: Bending your elbows so it turns into a dip.

commonErrors.zh: 沉下去太快，肩膀一下掉到耳朵
commonErrors.en: Dropping fast so your shoulders crash up to your ears.

cautions.zh: 肩膀前面夹着疼就少做几下；撑不住就脚踩地分担点体重
cautions.en: If the front of your shoulder pinches, do fewer. Can't hold yourself up? Keep your feet on the floor to take some weight.
